text:
tess: quick heads-up — ops wants to shorten telemetry retention for spans/attrs to 30d for cost reasons. Before we flip it we need a clear scrub + sampling plan for high-card attrs (prompt_text, user_id, request_id). can we lock an approach? :thinking:
ryan: +1 we should hash prompt_text and user_id at ingest, but keep prompt_hash only for aggregation. drop full request_id unless flagged. sampling on prompt_hash for low-volume hashes (e.g., sample 1% if <5k/day).
kaleb: agree, and we need an audit trail for any allowlisted routes that keep raw attrs. prefer doing attr ops in the otel collector so customers/private-deploys can opt-in.
maria: Console UX request: expose per-route retention override (team-scoped) + a clear banner when a route is allowlisted that says "raw telemetry stored" and requires an approver. also need a telemetry -> billing note so PMs understand cost impact.
ryan: ops/implementation detail: hashing needs a salt per-region/cluster so hashes can't be reverse engineered across customers. store salt in KMS; collector should support a "hash_with_kms" processor. also consider truncation for prompt_text to preserve length distribution for latency/cost models.
maria: truncation worries me, we use token-length distribution in several dashboards. if we truncate we must preserve a token_length attribute derived at ingest. that way dashboards keep P50/P95 token metrics without full prompts.
ryan: here's a draft otel-collector processor snippet we prototyped, feedback welcome:
```yaml
processors:
  attributes/scrub:
    actions:
      - action: hash
        key: prompt_text
        salt_from_kms: true
      - action: hash
        key: user_id
        salt_from_kms: true
      - action: delete
        key: request_id
      - action: insert
        key: prompt_token_count
        value_from: tokenizer_count(prompt_text)
```
kaleb: small concern: tokenization in collector adds CPU on ingest path. might need async enrich worker and a small cache for frequent prompt_hashes. also sampling logic should be after hashing so it works on prompt_hash cardinality, not raw text.
ingest-bot: config-pr opened: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/+/4567 — draft pipeline + tests. automated check: test-collector-load passed :heavy_check_mark:.
tess: solid thread — next steps: (1) ryan + kaleb to iterate collector PR and add kms-salt impl, (2) maria to mock Console banner + per-route override UX, (3) I'll sync with finance on retention cost delta. target to gate retention change behind a canary rollout and the allowlist approval flow. thanks all :+1:
